title: Hacer causal y auditable la métrica de sucesores por cierre en Live
mission: Replace the coarse global derived/terminal_returns ratio with a provenance-grounded reproduction metric that counts only successors durably linked to actual terminal returns.
definition_of_done: Count only successor jobs with durable causal linkage to actual terminal returns; unrelated derived jobs do not increase the numerator.
Expose grounded_successors, eligible_terminal_returns and ratio in the static feed.
Fixture: one unrelated derived job leaves the ratio unchanged; two linked successors from one eligible return count as two.
Production UI distinguishes grounded reproduction from plan completion.
